workarounds.note: headings.balancing.stretchAfterFloats is off: with it on, the closing page (a top float, a page-wide summary, a closing band) never settles and the build reports converged: false

splitMinLines counts the lines of the whole box on each side of a cut, not those of the step it cuts, so a two-line step can split one line and one (the body's widow and orphan rules do not reach a box's children); the text before the procedure is fitted so the cut falls between steps 4 and 5, checked in the VDT

the procedure's compass is a corner icon (position 'corner'), which takes no room: a continuation gives back an inline icon's column, so a cut between steps moves the rest of the box left by the icon and its gap, and a cut inside a step keeps only the gap, rewraps the step wider and prints words twice
ragged text can strand '(' or ')' next to a :ref; the log table is cited as 'tabla 4.2' (style full, case lower) without brackets, and '(Fig. 4.1)' sits mid-line, checked by eye
the worksheet is set ragged, and ragged text is never hyphenated: locale 'es' names the language but hyphenates nothing, so the 78 mm columns carry the rag (gotcha ragged-no-hyphenation)
the H1 breakBefore is restated because a headings object drops it
config.locale does not localise Figure and Table: resourceTypes: defaultResourceTypes(LANG) is passed by hand
col() writes the hex beside every paletteId, because the palette does not reach the opener's and running heads' design elements
the opener's design texts give lineHeight as a multiple (0.98, 1.4), never a Dimension, which would silently drop the opener
